```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
print(arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  print()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  print()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    categories |> dplyr::rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
      category_name,
      market_cap_usd,
      .fun = median,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(position = "fill") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 1.02,
    label = "Luna/UST crash",
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 1.02,
    label = "FTX collapse",
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9, name = "Category") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "How the Crypto Market Is Distributed Across Categories",
    subtitle = "Each band shows a category's share of total daily cryptocurrency market capitalization; shares sum to 100%.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market capitalization",
    caption = "Source: Daily cryptocurrency prices and market capitalizations; category classifications from the course dataset."
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = lubridate::parse_date_time(
      launch_date,
      orders = c("mdy", "ymd"),
      quiet = TRUE
    ) |>
      as.Date()
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(metadata$launch_date_parsed))

metadata |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  dplyr::arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
prices |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>

  )
```
